rule_or_pattern: drop lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out (chars-per-pixel outside the book range) whose label is NOT all-caps; on these the crop covers a different or larger text line than the label (all-caps headings with the same flag are correct and stay)
notes: A 1934 history with long quoted Venetian-Italian documents. The Italian lines (1-3, 19, 20, 32, 35, 37, 39) are genuinely Italian and correctly read, and the Greek polytonic body (4-18, 28, 29, 34) is clean, so the language flag is genre. A subset has crop/label mismatches. Line 22's crop shows '2 Aldobrandini καὶ Cassini εὐγενεῖς Βενετοί...' but is labelled '. Το Grisogono'; line 38's crop shows 'giudicato, che in corpo così grande...' but is labelled 'delle corruzioni; Però gelosi della'. Lines 23 and 33 are truncated or padded, and 36 adds text from the next line. All five carry cpp_vs_book_out, which otherwise flags only correct caps headings (21, 24, 25, 31). Minor: in 27 the 'сатра-' is Cyrillic, and 40 drops 'ἢ'.
